body:
The real-coefficient number-field adapter uses a private import solely to unfold Presentation.model while identifying the original factory model. Export Presentation.model_eq and rewrite that existing consumer proof with the public equation, removing import all HexRealClosureTheory.NumberFieldTower.

The model definition remains abstract through ordinary imports; the parenthesized rfl proof intentionally suppresses Lean's automatic defeq attribute. Extend the existing number-field conformance axiom audit to the equation and model_read, and document the development API. No model, arithmetic/search, factory or source-certification algorithm, package requirement or phase counter changes.

Validation: full monorepo build14,744; owner module10,824 and actual ordinary-import adapter/number-field conformance10,919; final consumer refresh passes after documentation polish. Import DAG,669 scanned adapter/conformance cones and Mathlib-free benchmark/proof boundaries pass. The existing sealed-import guard now rejects import all of this owner module, with all12 DAG regression tests passing. Fresh Opus review began immediately after opening and found no blockers; the documentation and import-boundary findings are addressed. Exact updated-head CI remains required.

Refs #10575, #10378, #10358.
title: Expose the number-field presentation model equation
